name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a royalty and streaming company focused on gold properties in Nevada and Idaho. The company acquires royalty and exploration stream interests on smaller producing, pre-production, and pre-resource properties, including the Lapon Canyon Project, Lazy Claims, Loman, and Agai-Pah properties in Nevada. It operates with low overhead by aggregating royalty packages rather than direct mining operations.
